scope: 256x256 half-float observer-dependent galaxy volume readbacks plus floating-point URP opaque-depth fixture. All viewpoints integrate the same bounded seeded 3D density. Submission/readback timings include synchronization and are not gameplay performance.

checks.name: Bounded galaxy produces continuous luminous structure in exterior view
Unchanged observer reuses deterministic radiance without another GPU integration
96-step overview converges toward the independent 192-step budget
Edge-on view has a thinner projected stellar disk than the oblique observer
Interior display retains a dark off-plane night sky instead of a gray luminous screen
Galactic band stays visibly luminous while the off-plane night sky remains dark
Seeded dust attenuates the interior disk and core
Dust lane changes a spatial area rather than only isolated stellar points
Seed changes three-dimensional arm phase and dust structures
Moving the galactic observer changes perspective rather than replaying a fixed background
Rays pointing away from the finite outer halo remain black
Zero optical exposure removes galactic emission
Far-depth volume respects real URP opaque geometry
URP composite preserves the actual integrated volume outside the opaque fixture
